notes: Roseires Dam’s signed concrete barrage and approach embankments, photographed buttresses, the central sluice chutes, power hall and downstream apron. The original model follows the 934 m mapped concrete outline and the adjacent mapped grade ties. More distant perimeter embankments remain in native terrain. The visible wall, seven gated lanes and low power hall follow the ordinary reference pictures and PMTiles alignment. Exact current gate, buttress, apron and machinery dimensions are visual interpretations. The 16 m terrain and modeled shore grades are approximate. Only the crest crossing is replaced. Both downstream bridges remain native.
